verse.unicode: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

transliteration.english: aasaa a(n)dhar sabh ko koi niraasaa hoi ||

en.bdb: Everyone is filled with hope; hardly anyone is free of hope.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak jo mar jeeviaa sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||

en.bdb: O Nanak, blessed is the birth of one, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਸਾ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਕੇਉ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

transliteration.english: naa kichh aasaa hath hai keau niraasaa hoi ||

en.bdb: Nothing is in the hands of hope. How can one become free of hope?

verse.unicode: ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਏਹ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਜਾਂ ਭੋੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: kiaa kare eh bapuRee jaa(n) bhuolaae soi ||2||

en.bdb: What can this poor being do? The Lord Himself creates confusion. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥

transliteration.english: dhirag jeevan sa(n)saar sache naam bin ||

en.bdb: Cursed is the life in this world, without the True Name.

verse.unicode: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ॥

transliteration.english: prabh dhaataa dhaataar nihachal eh dhan ||

en.bdb: God is the Great Giver of givers. His wealth is permanent and unchanging.

verse.unicode: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥

transliteration.english: saas saas aaraadhe niramal soi jan ||

en.bdb: That humble being is immaculate, who worships the Lord with each and every breath.
With your tongue, vibrate the One Inaccessible Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verse.unicode: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥

transliteration.english: rav rahiaa sarabat naanak bal jaiee ||20||

en.bdb: He is all-pervading everywhere. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||20||
